source: Pinned DDA full large karting circuit; existing BN types reused
bn_reuse: All kart engine, wheel, frame, steering, electrical and fuel-system parts
All rooms, roof utilities, furniture, terrain and ramp types
Stock vending drink/food groups and vending behavior
adaptations: xlframe#vertical becomes BN's generated xlframe_vertical; no new frame implementation
Site-local palette inlined into deferred mapgen objects
Explicit local_road connection replaces legacy terrain:road connection field
Unsupported lootable:true omitted; stock BN vending generation is used
DDA ITEM currency becomes BN GENERIC valuables with source descriptions and prices
Cash register uses BN CONTAINER with rigid 1 L capacity and source external weight/volume
DDA bash damage becomes BN bashing; structured DDA grip/balance modifier is omitted
limitations: DDA pocket shape filters and 2 kg pocket weight limit are not implemented; BN legacy container accepts general contents
DDA OLD_CURRENCY and pocket-shape flags are omitted; no global DDA barter or pocket system is introduced
Exact DDA vending damage/looting distribution is not claimed
Native load, actual generation and assembled vehicle tests are added but Windows results remain pending
checks: Original 72x72 rows, all floors, nested rooms and explicit placements preserved
All 48 ramp columns and source stairs match between levels
